400.description: Invalid argument - The client specified an invalid argument

401.description: Unauthenticated - The request does not have valid authentication credentials

403.description: Permission denied - The caller does not have permission to execute the specified operation

404.description: Not found - Some requested entity was not found

408.description: Deadline exceeded - The deadline expired before the operation could complete

409.description: Aborted - The operation was aborted due to concurrency issue

412.description: Failed precondition - Operation was rejected because the system is not in required state

413.description: Out of range - Operation was attempted past the valid range

429.description: Resource exhausted - Some resource has been exhausted (rate limiting)

431.description: Request header fields too large - Request metadata was too large

499.description: Cancelled - The operation was cancelled by the client

501.description: Unimplemented - The operation is not implemented or supported

503.description: Unavailable - The service is currently unavailable

504.description: Deadline exceeded - Upstream service did not respond in time

BetaManagedAgentsDeployment.description: A deployment is a configured instance of an agent — it binds the agent to everything needed to run it autonomously: an environment, credentials, initial events, and an optional schedule.

example.description: Compiles yesterday's orders into a report every weekday morning.
example.name: Daily order report

agent.description: Reference to the agent this deployment runs, resolved to a concrete version.

archived_at.description: Time the deployment was archived. Null if not archived.

budget.description: Spend ceiling stamped onto each session created from this deployment. Absent when no budget is set.

description.description: Description of what the deployment does.
examples: Compiles yesterday's orders into a report every weekday morning.

environment_id.description: ID of the `environment` where sessions run.

initial_events.description: Events sent to each session immediately after creation.

paused_reason.description: Why the deployment is paused. Non-null exactly when status is paused; null otherwise.

resources.description: Resources attached to sessions created from this deployment. Echoes the input minus write-only credentials.

schedule.description: Recurring cron schedule. Presence enables scheduled execution; null means manual-only. Includes computed timestamps (next fire times, last run) on the cron variant.

status.description: Computed status of the deployment: `active` or `paused`. Archived deployments report `active` with `archived_at` set.

updated_at.description: Time the deployment was last updated.

vault_ids.description: Vault IDs supplying stored credentials for sessions created from this deployment.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentReference.description: A resolved agent reference with a concrete version.

BetaManagedAgentsBudget.description: An enforced spend ceiling on a session. Discriminated on `type`; `limit` is the only kind currently supported.

BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentInitialEvent.description: An event sent to a session immediately after it is created. Supports `user.message`, `user.define_outcome`, and `system.message`.

BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentPausedReason.description: Why a deployment is paused. Non-null exactly when `status` is `paused`.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionResourceConfig.description: A configured session resource. Echoes the input minus write-only credentials.

BetaManagedAgentsSchedule.description: A recurring schedule with computed runtime timestamps. Discriminated union — only cron is supported currently.

BetaManagedAgentsBudgetLimit.description: A hard spend ceiling. The session stops issuing new model requests once the tracked list cost reaches `max_list_cost`.

max_list_cost.description: Maximum list cost the session may accrue. List price is used regardless of any negotiated discount, so the cap fires at or before the actual charge.

BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentUserMessageEv.description: A user message sent to the session.

content.description: Array of content blocks for the user message.

BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentUserDefineOut.description: An outcome the agent should work toward. The agent begins work on receipt.

description.description: What the agent should produce. This is the task specification.

max_iterations.description: Eval→revision cycles before giving up. Default 3, max 20.

rubric.description: How to grade the outcome. Text or file reference.

BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentSystemMessage.description: Privileged context for the accompanying turn and all subsequent turns, appended to the session's system context as a `role: "system"` turn rather than replacing the top-level system prompt.

content.description: System content blocks to append. Text-only.

BetaManagedAgentsManualDeploymentPausedR.description: The caller invoked the pause endpoint on the deployment.

BetaManagedAgentsErrorDeploymentPausedRe.description: A scheduled fire recorded a failed run whose error auto-pauses the deployment.

BetaManagedAgentsGitHubRepositoryResourc.description: A GitHub repository mounted into each session's container. The authorization token is write-only and never returned.

checkout.description: Branch or commit to check out. Defaults to the repository's default branch.

mount_path.description: Mount path in the container. Defaults to `/workspace/<repo-name>`.

BetaManagedAgentsFileResourceConfig.description: A file mounted into each session's container.

file_id.description: ID of a previously uploaded file.

mount_path.description: Mount path in the container. Defaults to `/mnt/session/uploads/<file_id>`.

BetaManagedAgentsMemoryStoreResourceConf.description: A memory store attached to each session created from this deployment.

access.description: Access mode for the mounted store. Defaults to read_write. read_only mounts the store as a read-only filesystem.

instructions.description: Per-attachment guidance for the agent on how to use this store. Rendered into the memory section of the system prompt. Max 4096 chars.

memory_store_id.description: The memory store ID (memstore_...). Must belong to the caller's organization and workspace.

BetaManagedAgentsCronSchedule.description: 5-field POSIX cron schedule with computed runtime timestamps.

expression.description: 5-field POSIX cron expression: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week (e.g., "0 9 * * 1-5" for weekdays at 9am). Day-of-week is 0-7 where 0 and 7 both mean Sunday. Extended cron syntax - seconds or year fields, and the special characters L, W, #, and ? - is not supported, nor are predefined shortcuts (@daily).

last_run_at.description: Time the most recent scheduled run actually started. Null until one completes; preserved after the deployment is archived. Manual runs do not update this.

upcoming_runs_at.description: Up to 5 timestamps of upcoming cron occurrences. Non-empty for active and paused deployments (reflects what the schedule would do if unpaused); empty once the deployment is archived (`archived_at` set). Each fire is offset by a small per-schedule jitter, so a run will actually start at or shortly after its listed time.

BetaMonetaryAmount.description: A monetary amount in a specific currency.

amount.description: Amount in minor units of the currency, as an integer decimal string with no leading zeros: "2500" is $25.00 and "50" is fifty cents. A string rather than a number so no float rounding is ever applied.

currency.description: Uppercase ISO-4217 currency code. `USD` is the only currency currently supported; the accepted set is closed and grows only when a new currency is priced.

BetaManagedAgentsUserContentBlock.description: Content block in a user message. Can be `text`, `image`, or `document`.

BetaManagedAgentsRubric.description: Rubric for grading the quality of an outcome.

BetaManagedAgentsSystemContentBlock.description: Content block in a mid-conversation system message. Text-only.

BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentPausedReasonE.description: The error that triggered an auto-pause. Matches the failed run's `error.type`.

BetaManagedAgentsMountMode.description: Access mode for an attached memory store.

BetaManagedAgentsImageBlock.description: Image content specified directly as base64 data or as a reference via a URL.

source.description: The source of the image data.

BetaManagedAgentsDocumentBlock.description: Document content, either specified directly as base64 data, as text, or as a reference via a URL.

context.description: Additional context about the document for the model.

source.description: The source of the document data.

BetaManagedAgentsRedactedBlock.description: Placeholder for content withheld by Anthropic model policy.

BetaManagedAgentsFileRubric.description: Rubric referenced by a file uploaded via the Files API.

BetaManagedAgentsTextRubric.description: Rubric content provided inline as text.

content.description: Rubric content. Plain text or markdown — the grader treats it as freeform text.

BetaManagedAgentsEnvironmentNotFoundDepl.description: The deployment's environment no longer exists.

BetaManagedAgentsVaultNotFoundDeployment.description: A vault referenced by the deployment no longer exists.

BetaManagedAgentsFileNotFoundDeploymentP.description: A file resource referenced by the deployment no longer exists.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionResourceNotFound.description: A referenced resource no longer exists and its kind was not reported.

BetaManagedAgentsMemoryStoreArchivedDepl.description: A memory store referenced by the deployment is archived.

BetaManagedAgentsSkillNotFoundDeployment.description: A skill referenced by the deployment's agent no longer exists.

BetaManagedAgentsVaultArchivedDeployment.description: A vault referenced by the deployment is archived.

BetaManagedAgentsUnknownDeploymentPaused.description: An unrecognized error auto-paused the deployment. A fallback variant; matches a run whose `error.type` is `unknown_error`.

BetaManagedAgentsSelfHostedResourcesUnsu.description: The deployment configures resources, but its environment is self-hosted and cannot mount them.

BetaManagedAgentsMcpEgressBlockedDeploym.description: An MCP server host used by the deployment's agent is blocked by the environment's network policy.

sha.description: Full commit SHA to check out.

BetaManagedAgentsImageSource.description: Union type for image source variants.

BetaManagedAgentsDocumentSource.description: Union type for document source variants.

url.description: URL of the image to fetch.

file_id.description: ID of a previously uploaded file.

media_type.description: MIME type of the text content. Must be "text/plain".

url.description: URL of the document to fetch.

file_id.description: ID of a previously uploaded file.
